description: This file contains functions for initializing and managing custom select dropdowns using the TomSelect library, including loading options asynchronously from a specified source.

methods.name: sqlpage_select_dropdown
methods.description: Initializes select dropdowns with the data-pre-init attribute by applying the TomSelect plugin.

methods.name: sqlpage_select_dropdown_individual
methods.description: Initializes a single select element with TomSelect, handling focus and form reset events.

methods.name: sqlpage_load_options_source
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous function to load options from a given source URL, handling various response validation checks.
